headline: Minister of Finance: We are working to change the tax reality for the better by strengthening the path of trust, partnership and support with the business community
summary: Finance Minister Ahmet Kacuk said economic activity is improving, with good performance in industrial and productive sectors over the past fiscal year. He pledged to strengthen trust with the business community.
why: The finance minister oversees Egypt's budget and tax policy. Official assessments of economic momentum inform views on the country's growth and fiscal outlook.
